corpus_note: Frozen against the CURRENT corpus (85 sections: 3 manuals + policies.md + 50 FAQ rows). Small corpus makes retrieval EASIER; do not oversell hit-rate vs a larger corpus. Corpus + set are frozen together.

scoring_split.answerable: hit-rate@k + context precision (retrieval) + sampled RAGAS faithfulness/relevancy + tool-call correctness
scoring_split.adversarial: pass/fail behavior only; EXCLUDED from hit-rate and faithfulness

matching_rules.hit_at_k: A hit = any acceptable_sources entry appears in the retriever's top-k. Section entries match on (source AND section_title); FAQ entries match on source==faqs.csv AND page_content contains content_contains (both frozen, no scoring-time judgment).
matching_rules.warranty_primary: Warranty items are scored by tool-call correctness (right tool + right serial), which is date-independent. The active/expired ANSWER is as-of 2026-07-17 (the tool reads datetime.now(); injectable clock deferred).
matching_rules.adversarial: injection = mechanical substring rule; refuse = llm_judge (named, indicative). Reported as a separate refusal-correct %, excluded from hit-rate and faithfulness.

items.question: What Wi-Fi band does the LumiGlow smart bulb need for setup?
items.expected_answer: A 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network; 5 GHz is not supported for initial setup.

items.question: How do I factory reset the LumiGlow bulb?
items.expected_answer: Toggle the light switch OFF and ON five times in a row; the bulb flashes multiple colors then resets to steady white. This erases all settings, so re-add the device.

items.question: What is the wattage and rated lifespan of the LumiGlow bulb?
items.expected_answer: 9W LED (60W incandescent equivalent), with an expected lifespan of 25,000 hours.

items.question: Can I dim the LumiGlow bulb with a physical wall dimmer switch?
items.expected_answer: No. It is not for use with standard dimmer switches; dimming is done via the Nexora Home App or voice assistants. A physical dimmer can damage it.

items.question: My LumiGlow light keeps flickering. What should I check?
items.expected_answer: Make sure the bulb is screwed in snugly, and confirm it is not connected to a physical dimmer switch (incompatible, causes flickering).

items.question: Is a C-wire required to install the Thermostat Pro?
items.expected_answer: A C-wire (common wire) is highly recommended for stable performance. It can work without one in some systems, but that may cause battery drain and connectivity issues.

items.question: The Thermostat Pro display is blank. How do I fix it?
items.expected_answer: Ensure the HVAC circuit breaker is ON, confirm the R and C wires are securely seated, and check that the HVAC drip pan/drain is not clogged (which can trip a safety shut-off).

items.question: How do I unfreeze a frozen Thermostat Pro screen?
items.expected_answer: Press and hold the physical reset button on the side of the display for 15 seconds until it reboots. This does not erase your settings.

items.question: What input voltage does the Thermostat Pro require?
items.expected_answer: 24V AC, supplied via the R and C terminals.

items.question: What are the adaptive learning and vacation mode features on the Thermostat Pro?
items.expected_answer: Adaptive Learning builds an energy-saving schedule from your habits in the first week; Vacation Mode holds an energy-saving temperature range while you are away.

items.question: How high should I mount the SecureSphere 360 camera for best AI detection?
items.expected_answer: Mount it 2.5 to 3 meters (8 to 10 feet) above the ground.

items.question: Is the SecureSphere 360 camera fully waterproof?
items.expected_answer: No. It is weather-resistant (IP65), not fully waterproof; it withstands rain and dust but must not be submerged. Best installed under an eave.

items.question: The camera's QR code scan during setup keeps failing. How do I fix it?
items.expected_answer: Clean the lens with a microfiber cloth, set phone brightness to maximum, and hold the phone steady 15 to 20 cm from the lens, adjusting distance slowly.

items.question: What video resolution does the SecureSphere 360 record at, and what microSD cards does it support?
items.expected_answer: 1920x1080p Full HD at 25fps; microSD up to 128GB, Class 10.

items.question: What does Privacy Mode do on the SecureSphere 360 camera?
items.expected_answer: It physically rotates the lens into the housing, disabling all video and audio recording until you turn it off.

items.question: What is the warranty period for the Thermostat Pro compared with the LumiGlow lights?
items.expected_answer: Thermostat Pro: 2-year limited warranty. LumiGlow Smart Lights: 1-year limited warranty.

acceptable_sources.content_contains: warranty period for the Thermostat Pro

items.question: Does the warranty policy cover water or flood damage?
items.expected_answer: No. Damage from accident, abuse, misuse, flood, fire, earthquake, or other external causes is excluded.

items.question: What is Nexora's return window and the condition for a full refund?
items.expected_answer: 30 days from purchase, in unused like-new condition and original packaging; an RMA number must be obtained first.

items.question: How long do refunds take to process and is there a restocking fee?
items.expected_answer: Refunds process within 7 to 10 business days after inspection; a 15% restocking fee may apply to returns not in original condition. Shipping charges are non-refundable.

items.question: What personal information does Nexora collect about me?
items.expected_answer: Personal info (name, email, address, phone), device and usage info (serial numbers, IP, WiFi SSID, activity/crash logs, settings), and app usage data.

items.question: Does Nexora sell my personal data to third parties?
items.expected_answer: No. Nexora does not sell, rent, or trade customer personal data; it may share with trusted service providers under confidentiality, or if required by law.

items.question: How long does Nexora commit to providing security updates for a product?
items.expected_answer: A minimum of five years from the product's official launch date, with at least 180 days public notice before End-of-Life.

items.question: What are the hours for human customer support?
items.expected_answer: Human agents are available 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM PST, Monday through Saturday.

turns.question: How do I install the LumiGlow bulb?
turns.expected_answer: Turn off power, screw the bulb into the E27 socket, restore power; it blinks slowly to enter pairing, then add it in the Nexora Home App.

turns.question: And what Wi-Fi does it need?
turns.expected_answer: A 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network (5 GHz is not supported for setup). Must resolve 'it' to the LumiGlow bulb from context.

turns.question: Is my Thermostat Pro under warranty?
What about my LumiGlow light?
turns.expected_answer: Expired (serial SN-NLRGB-LMO456). Must resolve to alice's LumiGlow from profile/context.

turns.question: What is the status of order NX-2025-301?
What items were in that order?
turns.expected_answer: SecureSphere 360 Camera and LumiGlow Smart Light. Must resolve 'that order' to NX-2025-301.

turns.question: How do I factory reset the LumiGlow bulb?
turns.expected_answer: Toggle the switch OFF/ON five times; it flashes colors then resets to white.

turns.question: Will that erase my settings?
turns.expected_answer: Yes, a factory reset erases all settings and you must re-add the device in the app. Must resolve 'that' to the reset.

turns.question: Does the warranty cover accidental water damage?
What about a manufacturing defect?
turns.expected_answer: Yes, hardware failures from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use are covered. Must contrast with the prior turn.
